objective: Carry a creator project from bounded content package into the current editor/render pipeline while preserving project identity, asset provenance and preview/export parity.
why: Prove the Crown contract across projects, editor, assets, rendering and publishing boundaries.
nonGoals: Do not replace the current video-package contract.
Do not claim unsupported preview/render parity.
Do not publish without explicit destination and payload approval.
acceptance: A project retains stable identity across package, editor and render stages.
Previewed supported features match exported output within documented limits.
Assets retain source/provenance references and missing assets fail explicitly.
Publishing remains a separate authorized step with destination/payload preview.
rollback: Revert mission-scoped integration edits; preserve existing project, package and render owners and generated artifacts.
